title: The standing wave reproduces itself on every Sierpinski simplex
claim: On the level-k Sierpinski d-simplex SG^d_k (copies of a (d+1)-bit law on the C(k+d-1, d) up simplices {v, v+e_1, ..., v+e_d}, base corner first, every vertex but the d+1 corners summed), the standing wave w^(y)(x) = (-1)^(x_0) U_(E-1)(y/2) (= (-1)^(x_0) sin(theta E)/sin(theta) at y = 2 cos(theta); E the sum of (-1)^(x_i)) has corner relation lambda_(d,k)(y) w^(y) for every d, k and every complex y, where lambda_(d,k) is a monic integer polynomial in y of degree d(#T - 1) with lambda(2) = 2^N and lambda(-y) = (-1)^(d(#T-1)) lambda(y); at level 2 it is y^d (y^2 - 2)^(d(d-1)/2). Proof: two phase sectors per copy, locked along the d edges from the base corner, with an odd global flip; the limit law 1 + sum_i s_0 s_i reproduces itself with factor 2^N because its only even edge sets are the empty set and the d axis paths. Consequences: finitely many exceptional angles per level, none at theta = j pi/q with q an odd prime power (2 cos(theta) is congruent to plus or minus 2 modulo the prime above q); the Legendre law (-1)^(x_0) (E|3) has factor congruent to (-1)^N mod 3 and is an exact knot on every SG^d_k for every d >= 2; for sin(2 theta) nonzero the support of w_theta is a knot (K1-K3) exactly when d is odd or theta = j pi/q with q odd and q <= d + 1. Hence knots build exact finitely ramified towers of similarity dimension log C(k+d-1, d)/log k, increasing to d, in every dimension.
failure_conditions: A dimension d, level k and angle theta with sin(theta) nonzero at which the corner relation of w_theta is not proportional to w_theta.
A case where the factor is not a monic integer polynomial in y = 2 cos(theta) of degree d(#T - 1), or where its value at y = 2 is not 2^N.
An edge set of the kind used for the limit law, with even degree at every vertex but the corners, other than the empty set and the d axis paths.
An angle j pi/q with q an odd prime power at which the factor vanishes.
A pair (d, theta) with d >= 2 and sin(2 theta) nonzero at which the knot test of the support disagrees with the stated criterion.
foundation_claim_scope: Signed and real (d+1)-bit laws on level-k Sierpinski d-simplices (finite gadgets for every d and k, and the towers they generate level by level); exactness of the corner relation; the knot status of the support under K1-K3.

validation.status: checked: closed forms for d = 1 to 7 on all tuples; Legendre exactness in exact integers for d = 2 (k <= 7), 3 (k <= 5), 4 (k <= 3), 5 to 7 (k <= 2); the factor polynomial (identity at d#T + 3 values modulo three primes, monic degree d(#T-1), parity, lambda(+-2), level-2 closed form, stable under three further primes) for 11 cases; the sector formula in 8 cases; the edge-set lemma exactly in every exactness case and by enumeration in 8; exact gcds with minimal polynomials of 2 cos(2 pi/n), n <= 60 (only n = 4, 8 occur); the knot criterion for d = 2 to 9, q <= 13, and knotlab on six supports; towers of levels 2 and 3 in 8 cases; floating point at four angles in 12 cases; controls fire; the proof for every d and k is in proof.md; no human or external review
